page_policy: Case IDs, just verbs, and Python/Rust may appear; function/type/file names stay here

anchors.claim: Suite drives both installed libraries through public APIs, checks a shared oracle, then requires Python/Rust parity
Drivers must not implement routing, checkpointing, request tracking, or iteration behavior
Each case carries one Expected observation; both participants are checked against that same record
After both observations exist, parity compares them with only participant removed
Both participants are mandatory; a missing driver is infrastructure failure, not a skip
Python and Rust drivers construct graphs and call library public APIs; they do not reimplement fan-out, switch, or checkpoint restore
just check probes both drivers then runs every hermetic case
Required cases are WF-001 through WF-010
Product verbs are doctor, list, run, version; just exposes doctor/list/run/check
No case uses a model, network, ambient credential, or external service
